biotools.summary: AsaruSim is a workflow for simulating synthetic single-cell long-read Nanopore datasets, designed to mimic real experimental data and facilitate the evaluation of isoform detection methods. The workflow incorporates multiple steps, including count matrix creation, read generation, optional PCR amplification, error introduction, and quality control reporting.
